name: @dxjs/charts
description: CSP-safe chart components for dxjs: a thin, signal-reactive wrapper over Chart.js (bar / line / pie / doughnut) rendered to a <canvas>.
//exports: Dev points at TS source. The stylesheet ships as ./charts.css and is linked same-origin (style-src 'self'). Chart.js draws to <canvas> (no eval, no inline style), so the kit runs under a strict CSP.
